instruction_problem: The gap allows several answers (never, rarely, seldom, hardly ever, and the negative don't/can't), so the key must accept all; the prompt "How often?" does not say whether one word or more is wanted. "don't"/"can't" do not answer "How often?" but are correct English.
level_problem: Frequency adverbs are A2 content; light for B1.1 (only the because-clause logic makes it B1).
sense_problem: Only negative-frequency answers fit the because-clause; usually/always/often are wrong, which is believable. Sentence is natural.
